title: AAE cross-profile composition vector
description: Schema for a composition vector that pairs one AAE (draft-kroehl-agentic-trust-aae-00) with one artifact from another profile and states the composed verdict. This schema EXTENDS the vector set; it does not replace schema/vector-schema.json, which continues to govern the 15 AAE-native vectors in vectors/ unchanged. A composition vector carries two join axes: join_what (the shared action digest) and join_who (the principal resolution). Both must hold for AUTHORIZED.

id.description: Composition-vector id, distinct from the aae-vector-NN namespace of the native set.

status.description: 'proposed' until a second independent implementation recomputes the vector, per Section 7 of draft-mih-sato-agent-accountability-composition-00. A composition vector whose join_who convention has not been confirmed by the counterpart profile MUST stay 'proposed'.

section_ref.description: AAE draft sections exercised on the AAE side, plus any counterpart-profile references.

verification_mode.description: Same derivation axis as the native set: 'structural' = the verdict follows from document-only properties; 'runtime' = it requires live external state (clock, revocation lookup, consumed-id tracking). Orthogonal to enforcement posture.

secured_aae.description: The AAE side: JWS in compact serialization (header.payload.signature).

context.description: Facts a static file cannot reproduce live, passed to the AAE Section 5 algorithm unchanged. Same shape as the native vector set.

secondary_artifact.description: The non-AAE artifact this vector composes with. Embedded exactly as the counterpart profile published it — never re-encoded, re-signed, or normalized.

format.description: Wire format of `token`, e.g. 'JWS compact serialization, typ psea-proof+jwt, alg ES256'.

artifact_id.description: Identifier the source fixture gives the artifact, e.g. PSEA-A.

token.description: The artifact verbatim as delivered by the counterpart profile.

signer_kid.description: kid from the artifact's protected header; the key it is verified against must be the enrolled key carrying this kid.

enrollment_binding.description: The principal label the source fixture binds `signer_kid` to. Copied from the fixture, not derived.

native_verdict.description: The verdict the counterpart profile's own verifier returns for this artifact, as the source fixture records it. A composition vector never restates it.

payload_digest.description: The action digest the artifact commits to, in the counterpart profile's own wire encoding.

source.description: Provenance of the artifact, so a reviewer can re-fetch and re-hash it.

sha256.description: SHA-256 over the exact bytes of the source fixture file. Integrity pin.

join_what.description: Axis 1 — the shared action digest. Both profiles hash the SAME action payload with the SAME canonicalization and compare the resulting 32 octets.

definition.const: SHA-256 over JCS (RFC 8785) of the action payload

comparison_rule.const: compare the 32 octets, never the encoded strings
comparison_rule.description: A string comparison across encodings reports a mismatch on identical octets. Every wire form in this vector decodes to 32 octets before comparison.

payload.description: The action payload in cleartext. Integers only: no floating-point numbers, no decimal fractions, no exponent notation (draft-yossif-psea-02 Section 2.5). Monetary values are integer minor units. JSON Schema cannot see the lexical form of a number, so tools/validate_interop_schema.py additionally re-parses the raw file bytes with a Decimal float hook and fails on any non-integer numeric literal.

payload_jcs_utf8.description: The RFC 8785 canonical UTF-8 form of `payload`, recorded so a reviewer can diff canonicalizers without running one.

join_who.description: Axis 2 — the principal resolution. PROPOSED CONVENTION, PENDING CROSS-RUN CONFIRMATION. Neither draft-kroehl-agentic-trust-aae-00 nor draft-yossif-psea-02 fixes a shared principal identifier space: AAE names a principal with a DID in mandate.principal_did, the counterpart profile binds a kid to a deployment-issued label. This table is the DECLARED mapping of both identifier forms onto one canonical space. It is data in the vector, never inferred by a verifier at run time. Until the counterpart profile confirms it, every vector using it carries status 'proposed'.

canonical_space.description: URN prefix of the canonical principal space both sides map into.

unresolved_rule.const: an identifier with no entry in the table is unresolved
unresolved_rule.description: Absence of an entry is a missing input, not a conflict. It yields INDETERMINATE, never REFUSE.

secondary.description: enrollment_binding label -> canonical principal. The kid -> label hop comes from the counterpart fixture's own enrollment_bindings and is not restated here.

composition_verdict.description: AUTHORIZED: both natives pass, both digests join on 32 identical octets, and both principals resolve to the same canonical principal. REFUSE: a conflict was observed. INDETERMINATE: an input needed to decide is missing. REFUSE and INDETERMINATE never collapse into each other.

reason.description: principal_divergence: both principals resolved and differ (REFUSE). unresolved_binding: at least one principal has no entry in the resolution table (INDETERMINATE). join_mismatch: the two action digests differ on the octets (INDETERMINATE). aae_native_reject / secondary_native_reject: a native verification failed and its rejection is propagated, so the composition layer never ran (REFUSE). Required whenever composition_verdict is not AUTHORIZED.

aae_native.description: What the unmodified AAE Section 5 algorithm returns for input.secured_aae.

secondary_native.description: What the counterpart profile's own verification returns for input.secondary_artifact.

encoded_digest.description: A digest carried in a declared wire encoding. The encoding is data, not a guess: a consumer decodes it to raw octets and compares octets. base64url-nopad is the AAE-native form (matching the sha-256:<base64url> shape used elsewhere in the draft), base64-pad is the PSEA wire form, hex is the third form seen in practice.

value.description: The digest as the producing side writes it, including any profile-specific prefix such as 'sha-256:'.

octets.description: Decoded length. Every allowed encoding normalizes to 32 octets; anything else is a length mismatch, not an encoding difference.
